pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark brown patches are irregularly polygonal with soft-edged pixel gradients. Relative spatial area is highest in the central flank, with patches becoming smaller and more elongated towards the lower periphery.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned interstitial pathways form a continuous network. Junction nodes are primarily three-way intersections. The pathway thickness is relatively uniform, though visibility decreases towards the edges of the frame due to lens distortion and lighting.
